primarySources.summary: Publisher permits monetized streaming and edited highlights. Public official source is chosen rather than an unrelated creator recording. This does not prove a blanket license for every third-party asset or final public rights.

Two Point guidelines cover SEGA-published games and permit uploads/streams with original creative commentary and platform partner monetization. Mere copies of official content are disallowed. Other creators need permission; third-party music rights remain separate. Officially released promotional materials are eligible before release. No claim of affiliation or endorsement.

Individual creators may use SEGA-owned game content subject to specific product rules, independent third-party permissions, and commentary. Platform partner monetization is an exception to the business-use restriction. Publicly released promotional content may be used; avoid presenting people likenesses as reusable game assets.

Official announcement identifies Two Point Studios and SEGA; museum management involves exhibit layout, expeditions, visitor needs and security. These are research concepts, not evidence of the developers using an outline.
Museum-specific PS5 FAQ refers gameplay/screenshot use to SEGA streaming guidelines; this is supplemental to Two Point creator policy, not a PC recording license claim.

boundaries: Our outline is an analytical design proposal, not the games original planning document.
A hierarchy groups ideas; dependencies may cross branches and are not the same structure.
Static menus/tutorial panels, intros/titles/cinematics and stream countdowns do not count as actual play.
No third-party source audio/music or presenter likeness in final game excerpts.
Normal speed, non-overlapping concept-matched action cuts only; insufficient material requires fresh cuts/games.
